statement: 采用 HTTP Range 与稳定对象标识恢复；ETag、长度或版本改变时不得拼接两份内容。链接过期可续签同一不可变对象，已校验分段继续复用。

rules.text: Range 请求固定 object_id、长度、摘要和强 ETag 条件；临时 URL 只是访问位置。
implemented: Exact response range/ETag and signed chunk/whole SHA
rules.gap: Explicit Accept-Encoding identity request/response constraint is absent.

rules.text: 恢复接受匹配的 206/Content-Range；非零偏移收到 200 不允许追加。
rules.qualification: Status/range property inspected; encoding omission is D01.

rules.text: 416 需核对长度并完整校验，不能直接视为下载成功；错误页不能写进分段文件。
implemented: 416 is rejected before reading/writing archive body
200 and disguised error content cannot pass status/range/chunk SHA
rules.gap: No dedicated 416 local length and complete-hash branch.
rules.non_finding_reason: No corrupt success or recoverable completion failure established. Complete valid local archives are rehashed without an HTTP request; conforming unchanged objects do not return 416 for valid missing ranges.

rules.text: URL 续签只能授予同一对象，身份改变需新版本任务并显式处理旧临时数据。
rules.qualification: Inspected service/task boundary; production object-store/CDN immutability unverified.
implemented: New task UUID isolates another release; existing task manifest is not rebound

findings.title: Range requests omit the specified identity content encoding constraint
findings.required: Request Accept-Encoding: identity and check identity on 206.
findings.actual: Api.open supplies only Range and If-Range; TransferWorker checks status/range/ETag/size/SHA but no Content-Encoding.
reproducer: Prepare a task with one correct 8 MiB chunk and a controlled origin that serves the ordinary immutable representation for explicit Accept-Encoding identity and chooses an encoded representation otherwise.
Resume the task; observe Range/If-Range without explicit identity header.
Encoded response fails range/ETag/length/hash checks and is retried until the generic failure limit despite an identity representation being available.
Capture request header assertion and retained prefix/final state; no such procedure was executed in this review.
findings.impact_limit: No corrupt-file or automatic transparent-decompression vulnerability established. Normal local server serves identity. Operational failure depends on origin/CDN representation behavior.
refutations_retained: Cached OkHttp 4.12.0 BridgeInterceptor bytecode offsets 154-184: auto gzip requires absent Range; 290-423: transparent decompression requires that flag.
Original signed chunk/whole SHA checks prevent encoded or wrong content from becoming a successful archive.
findings.proposed_scope_for_review: Explicit request/response identity constraints and controlled encoding coverage.

observations_not_counted_as_integrity_fi.disposition: Safe rejection; no reachable corrupt-success consequence established.

observations_not_counted_as_integrity_fi.observation: Client does not compare every grant field to persisted manifest, validate strong ETag syntax, or persist ETag.
observations_not_counted_as_integrity_fi.disposition: Backend preserves those identities and original signed chunk/full SHA prevents wrong-byte success; changed-grant corruption claim not confirmed.

observations_not_counted_as_integrity_fi.observation: Every object 401/403 triggers one renewal; 404/410 are generic range errors and do not refresh policy in the worker.
observations_not_counted_as_integrity_fi.disposition: Authorization bypass refuted; protocol handling / DL-09 overlap. Not separately counted here.

observations_not_counted_as_integrity_fi.observation: Production presigning uses immutable logical object key without inspected deployed bucket/CDN policy.
observations_not_counted_as_integrity_fi.disposition: Deployment evidence boundary, not proof of mutable production content.
